# pimeta package

## Prediction Intervals for Random-Effects Meta-Analysis

An implementation of prediction intervals for random-effects
meta-analysis:

- Higgins JPT, Thompson SG, Spiegelhalter DJ. A re-evaluation of
  random-effects meta-analysis. *Journal of the Royal Statistical
  Society: Series A (Statistics in Society)* 2009; **172**(1): 137–159.
  [doi:10.1111/j.1467-985X.2008.00552.x](https://doi.org/10.1111/j.1467-985X.2008.00552.x).
- Partlett C, Riley RD. Random effects meta-analysis: Coverage
  performance of 95% confidence and prediction intervals following REML
  estimation. *Statistics in Medicine* 2017; **36**(2): 301–317.
  [doi:10.1002/sim.7140](https://doi.org/10.1002/sim.7140).
- Nagashima K, Noma H, Furukawa TA. Prediction interval for
  random-effects meta-analysis: a confidence distribution approach.
  *Statistical Methods in Medical Research* 2019; **28**(6): 1689–1702.
  [doi:10.1177/0962280218773520](https://doi.org/10.1177/0962280218773520).
  [arXiv:1804.01054](https://arxiv.org/abs/1804.01054).

[CRAN task view: Meta
Analysis](https://cran.r-project.org/view=MetaAnalysis)

## Installation

\
`# From CRAN:`\
[`install.packages`](https://rdrr.io/r/utils/install.packages.html)`(``"pimeta"``)`\
\
`# Or the development version from GitHub:`\
`# install.packages("devtools")`\
`devtools``::`[`install_github`](https://devtools.r-lib.org/reference/install-deprecated.html)`(``"nshi-stat/pimeta"``)`

# Package index

## All functions

- [`cima()`](https://nshi-stat.github.io/pimeta/reference/cima.md) :
  Calculating Confidence Intervals
- [`clbp`](https://nshi-stat.github.io/pimeta/reference/clbp.md) :
  Chronic low back pain data
- [`convert_bin()`](https://nshi-stat.github.io/pimeta/reference/convert_bin.md)
  : Converting binary data
- [`convert_mean()`](https://nshi-stat.github.io/pimeta/reference/convert_mean.md)
  : Converting means and standard deviations
- [`hyp`](https://nshi-stat.github.io/pimeta/reference/hyp.md) :
  Hypertension data
- [`i2h()`](https://nshi-stat.github.io/pimeta/reference/i2h.md) :
  \\(I^2\\) heterogeneity measure
- [`nfld`](https://nshi-stat.github.io/pimeta/reference/nfld.md) :
  Nonalcoholic fatty liver disease data
- [`pain`](https://nshi-stat.github.io/pimeta/reference/pain.md) : Pain
  data
- [`pima()`](https://nshi-stat.github.io/pimeta/reference/pima.md) :
  Calculating Prediction Intervals
- [`plot(`*`<cima>`*`)`](https://nshi-stat.github.io/pimeta/reference/plot.cima.md)
  : Plot Results
- [`plot(`*`<pima>`*`)`](https://nshi-stat.github.io/pimeta/reference/plot.pima.md)
  : Plot Results
- [`print(`*`<cima>`*`)`](https://nshi-stat.github.io/pimeta/reference/print.cima.md)
  : Print Results
- [`print(`*`<pima>`*`)`](https://nshi-stat.github.io/pimeta/reference/print.pima.md)
  : Print Results
- [`print(`*`<pima_tau2h>`*`)`](https://nshi-stat.github.io/pimeta/reference/print.pima_tau2h.md)
  : Print Results
- [`pwchisq()`](https://nshi-stat.github.io/pimeta/reference/pwchisq.md)
  : The Distribution of a Positive Linear Combination of Chiqaure Random
  Variables
- [`sbp`](https://nshi-stat.github.io/pimeta/reference/sbp.md) :
  Systolic blood pressure (SBP) data
- [`setshift`](https://nshi-stat.github.io/pimeta/reference/setshift.md)
  : Set-shifting data
- [`tau2h()`](https://nshi-stat.github.io/pimeta/reference/tau2h.md) :
  Calculating Heterogeneity Variance
